title: Qt: Use Qt [save|restore]Geometry for GeometryStateDialog
description:
As in e9de04264413a7dc328bffcb17e93446eb5bc412, the Qt functions
do a better job tracking which monitor a maximized window is on,
tracking the non-maximized state of a maximized window, etc.
Note that we've been storing and restoring the "full screen"
status of Dialogs, which is not the same as being maximized.
The Qt functions track both, and are supposed to handle making
sure the dialogs are on screen, etc.

Continue to write the other toolkit compatible method and fall back
to it, for supporting using recent files across versions.

Rename our saveGeometry() function for clarity, because it has the
same parameter list (but different return value) as the QWidget
function that returns the QByteArray even though it isn't exactly
an override. (Our function also writes to our settings file.)
